title: Loaded Baked Potato Soup
creator: Porch,Wine, and Gravy
prepTime: About 1 hour to bake the potatoes
cookTime: About 20 minutes on the stove (roux 1 minute, about 15 minutes to thicken, then finishing)
ingredients: Cajun seasoning, salt & pepper, to taste
instructions: Step 1: Bake the potatoes at 400 degrees F for about an hour. Scoop out the insides and break into chunks.
Step 2: Melt the butter in a Dutch oven, whisk in the flour, and cook for 1 minute.
Step 3: Slowly whisk in the milk and cook, stirring, until thickened, about 15 minutes.
Step 4: Stir in the potatoes, seasoning, half the bacon, and 1 cup of the cheese.
Step 5: Lower the heat and stir in the sour cream.
Step 6: Serve topped with the green onions and the rest of the bacon and cheese.
notes: From a Porch,Wine, and Gravy Facebook reel; the recipe is written out in the caption ('a baked potato in a bowl with all the toppings' - a cold-weather tradition the creator says only gumbo beats). The caption says the full story and a printable recipe are on the creator's blog (link in bio, not captured) and that the recipe is also in the comments. Not stated: servings and the amount of Cajun seasoning (to taste).
